key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated prior to landfall
Subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic
evidence_snippets: On 12th October 2013, Phailin Cyclone crossed the coastline… south of the city of Brahmapur in Odisha.
In total there were 18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected… significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Due to the cyclone there were 21 deaths but the subsequent floods claimed 23 more lives in Odisha and 1 life in Andhra Pradesh.
missing_information: Exact dates for the subsequent inland floods not specified
Damage and loss figures beyond evacuations and fatalities not provided
